outcome: pH < 7.10 in cord blood at birth
cohort: The study included twin pregnancies of mothers over 45 years at delivery as cases (n=22) and three controls (n=65) for each case, also pregnant women over 45 years.
finding: Advanced maternal age is an independent risk factor for adverse perinatal outcomes and obstetric complications, with twin gestations further increasing risks such as prematurity, NICU admission, and Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly more frequent in the twin group compared to the singleton group (90.9% vs 49.2%).
